message.content: Rowan finds the intriguing aspect of Jaime Lannister's storyline his transformation and the bond he forms with Brienne of Tarth. This bond significantly shapes his character arc, leading to a more complex and multi-dimensional portrayal of Jaime. As Rowan notes, "I love how Jaime's arc is fascinating! His relationship with Brienne really humanizes him." This relationship forces Jaime to confront his past and his motivations, pushing him towards a deeper understanding of his own character and the consequences of his actions.
